title: Shift Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Shift Manufacturing Engineer / Sr. Engineer Grade: E2
 Experience: 3-7 Years
 Qualification: Diploma / BE in Mechanical Engineering
 Job Location: Odhav & Kheda
 No. of Vacancies: 17 
 About the Role We are looking for Shift Manufacturing Engineers / Sr. Engineers to manage and monitor end-to-end manufacturing activities, with a strong focus on fabrication processes, production planning, quality, contractor management, and timely execution of manufacturing targets . 
 Candidates with experience in the heavy engineering, pressure vessel, process equipment, fabrication, or similar industries will be preferred. 
 Key Responsibilities Plan and monitor daily production activities in coordination with contractors to achieve production targets. Manage and monitor the end-to-end fabrication process to ensure smooth and timely execution. Coordinate closely with Quality Control, Design, Radiography, Purchase, Maintenance, Stores, Planning, and Cutting Yard teams to ensure uninterrupted production. Monitor manufacturing activities at various stages and ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements. Identify, control, and resolve non-conformities during the manufacturing process in coordination with the Quality team. Study and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and applicable standards such as ASME Codes, TEMA , and other relevant codes. Prepare and maintain manufacturing-related documentation required for ISO, ASME "U" Stamp , and other statutory/quality requirements. Coordinate and organize sandblasting and painting activities as per project requirements. Coordinate with Planning and Purchase teams for effective material availability, movement, and storage . Facilitate and monitor job contractors to ensure timely completion and expedite the overall manufacturing process. Track production progress and proactively highlight delays, bottlenecks, and operational issues. Ensure adherence to defined safety guidelines and shop-floor practices . Work effectively in a rotational shift environment as required. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, quality, and manufacturing efficiency. 
 Mandatory Skills Strong knowledge of the end-to-end fabrication process . Experience in manufacturing/fabrication of heavy engineering or process equipment will be preferred. Ability to understand engineering drawings and technical specifications. Working knowledge of ASME Codes and TEMA will be an advantage. Experience in contractor coordination and shop-floor production monitoring. Candidates from similar industries will be given preference . 
 Preferred Skills Basic understanding of QEHS Quality, Environment, Health & Safety . Good production planning and coordination skills. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Confident and proactive approach. Learning-oriented and willing to take ownership. Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet production timelines. Willingness to work in rotational shifts . 
 Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should be a Diploma / BE Mechanical professional with 3-7 years of relevant manufacturing/fabrication experience , preferably from a similar heavy engineering or process equipment industry. The candidate should be comfortable working on the shop floor, coordinating with multiple stakeholders and contractors, and managing manufacturing activities in a rotational shift environment .

Key Skills: Heavy Fabrication,Production Engineering,Process Engineering,Manufacturing Engineering,Fabrication,Reactors,Heat Exchangers,Vessels
